obsidian_vault_roundtrip.overall_conclusion: failure; Ubuntu and macOS failed in the initial attempt, while the Windows same-SHA rerun passed.

platform_findings.ubuntu: The artifact screenshot shows the focused Ctrl+L location entry containing the full absolute fixture path. Pressing Return closed the dialog, but OpenObsidian remained on the no-vault screen and logged ENOENT while canonicalizing the selected vault.
platform_findings.macos: The native Open panel appeared. Accessibility reported AXWindow:Open and AXWindow:OpenObsidian, but the nested AXButton lookup did not find the panel's visible Open control.
platform_findings.windows_initial_attempt: The initial folder selection opened the fixture, but the second Open vault action stayed disabled in UI Automation and did not create a native picker window.
platform_findings.windows_same_sha_rerun: The full round-trip and cancellation passed: the picker opened and closed with Escape, the original vault and two-note count returned, vault snapshots matched through close, and app-data snapshots were unchanged. Obsidian reopened the authored note and attachment path.

correction: For Linux, click the visible folder-dialog confirmation button after entering the focused absolute path instead of pressing Return. For macOS, use the accessibility-discovered Open panel window bounds to click its visible Open control and capture before/after screenshots. Keep Windows unchanged because the same-SHA rerun passed.
execution_policy: No local tests, builds, formatters, linters, application launches, or executable validation were run. All validation used GitHub Actions.
